title: fyniq-scenario-result@1
description: What the Go engine and the Python oracle each write for a fyniq-scenario@1 scenario; the comparator diffs two of them to the cent (QA-ENG-02). README.md beside this file states how to compare them.

entries.description: Every posted entry: the documents in scenario order, then the reversals in scenario order.

amount.description: At the line currency's minor units.

base_amount.description: At the base currency's minor units.

rejected.description: The refused documents ('<id>') and reversals ('<id>/reversal'), in the order they were refused. No reason codes.

trial_balance.description: Posting month -> account -> base-currency total of the month's lines. An account whose total is zero may be left out; a comparator reads a missing account or month as zero.

decimal.description: A plain decimal string: no exponent, no '+', no grouping.
